name: Clerk Hobby
free_limit: Clerk Hobby Free: 50K monthly retained users (MRU) per application, unlimited applications, up to 3 dashboard seats
watch_out: MRU counts retained users, not the same as monthly active users (MAU). Hobby needs no card; it has 1-day application-log retention, fixed 7-day sessions and limited impersonation. B2B add-on Free supports 100 monthly retained organizations with up to 20 members each; paid SSO/advanced controls are separate.
